# Nine Featured examples have no proof line

## Context

An example card on the Portal shows a title and one proof line: what the example proves. Nine of the 28 Featured examples have none, so their cards show a bare title. Found on 16 Nov 2026 by a review and by a read of the catalog. A leaf of #21140.

> **Second reconciliation, 16 Nov 2026, 19:15Z: PR #21162 delivers this leaf whole, and it closes with that merge.** Turning the groups into data (#21141) gives every record a home group, so the nine records needed their pairs there for the unit spec to pass, and Grace wrote and ran all nine. The same pull request widens the unit rule to every record that publishes a card ("every record that publishes a card has both a feature and an observation, with rejecting controls"), which is the guard asked for here. Nothing is left to build on this ticket.

**First reconciliation, 16 Nov after intake** ([Euclid's receipts](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/issues/21147#issuecomment-6921224304)): eight of the nine pairs also stand in two open contributor pull requests. This ticket's sweep searched its own words and missed them.

## The Problem

In `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json` on `dev`, these Featured records have no `feature` and no `lookFor`: `helix`, `offscreen-canvas`, `tab-container`, `state-provider`, `dialog-drag-drop`, `covid-helix`, `covid-gallery`, `gallery`, `liquid-glass`.

A first-time visitor sees, for example, "Helix" over a picture and nothing that says what it shows or why it matters.

| Pair exists in | Records |
|---|---|
| PR #21162 (for #21141), head `06056baf09` | all nine |
| #21105 (for #20695), head `3896a825` | `helix`, `offscreen-canvas`, `covid-helix`, `covid-gallery`, `gallery`, `liquid-glass` |
| #20824 (for #20694), head `38f67e4b` | `tab-container`, `dialog-drag-drop` |

**Which text stays** was read against the running examples on 16 Nov ([the read on PR #21162](https://github.com/neomjs/neo/pull/21162#issuecomment-6926342053)): PR #21162's on all nine, with three corrections asked there (`gallery`, `covid-gallery`, `state-provider`). The first reconciliation said that no pair of a contributor is replaced; that line is withdrawn for these eight records, because a caption's visible step has to exist: four of the six pairs of #21105 name a control or a gesture the example does not have, and the two of #20824 are true of every tab container and of a dialog that is not open on arrival. The contributors' new records and their captions are untouched by this.

## The Architectural Reality

- `apps/portal/resources/data/examples.json`: `feature` is one sentence on what the example proves; `lookFor` names one action and what to see. Good models in the same file: `grid-big-data`, `workstation`, `calendar`.
- `apps/portal/view/examples/List.mjs` renders `feature` as the card's proof line.
- `test/playwright/unit/apps/portal/view/examples/TabContainerController.spec.mjs` on `dev` rejects a family record without both fields; PR #21162 makes that every record that publishes a card.

## The Fix

None here. PR #21162 carries the nine pairs and the rule; its three caption corrections are asked on that pull request.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] All nine records carry `feature` and `lookFor` on `dev`, through PR #21162.
- [ ] `feature` says what the example proves in one sentence; `lookFor` names one action and its visible result, and each step named exists in the running example (the three corrections of the read are in).
- [ ] No sentence names a commercial feature.
- [ ] The unit case fails on a Featured record without both fields, and passes.

## Out of Scope

Covers; the card's design; records that are not Featured; the served-build limits the intake run found (Gallery in dev mode, the dialog's production URL, an OffscreenCanvas control before the canvas is ready): they are inputs to the slate, #21142.

### Intake reconciliation and live receipts

The exact-ticket search missed overlapping work in older catalog pull requests. I checked their source before editing the catalog:

| Existing caption custody | Exact head | Featured records |
|---|---|---|
| #21105 / #20695 | `3896a825343ac5b9444bdcce2f16023fb7db3d8b` | helix, offscreen-canvas, covid-helix, covid-gallery, gallery, liquid-glass |
| #20824 / #20694 | `38f67e4b3880feb9134737ca15a14a4fd2ca2765` | tab-container, dialog-drag-drop |

Those eight pairs remain with their contributors. My branch adds only the remaining `state-provider` pair and extends the existing catalog/render checks to Featured-only records. State & Data's new-record/family work stays with `#20696`. The guard cannot land against current dev until the incumbent pairs land or their authors explicitly transfer that work; the current red is the first missing `helix feature`.

**Proposed scope reconciliation for the author:** retain all nine captions as the outcome, supply eight through the existing PRs and the State Provider pair/guard here, and preserve the dependencies instead of publishing competing replacements.

Live actions, Chromium **158.0.8127.18**, normal browser UA, **1280×900**, 16 Nov 2026:

| Record | Build run | Action and observed result |
|---|---|---|
| helix | Dev mode | Rotate changed 0→144; the rendered image transforms changed. |
| offscreen-canvas | Dev mode, external published app | Stop Animation froze the canvas while its clock advanced; Start Animation resumed changing frames. |
| tab-container | Production | “Tab 1 text” changed to Planning; the same header DOM id displayed Planning. |
| state-provider | Dev mode | Editing `data.button2Text` to Project updated both toolbar labels, including lowercase `project`. |
| dialog-drag-drop | Dev mode | After its actual drag proxy appeared, the header drag moved the proxy and the landed dialog from (384,364) to (495,430). |
| covid-helix | Dev mode | Cases sorting changed the first countries from Afghanistan to USA, India, France. |
| covid-gallery | Dev mode | The same sort reordered the displayed country cards. |
| gallery | Production | Order by Row changed the first five image transforms from column-first to row-first; 300 items were rendered. |
| liquid-glass | Production, external published app | The SVG glass mask moved across the image; its x/y changed and the filtered region moved with it. |

The liquid-glass observation supports an automatically moving mask, rather than a pointer-following caption. The run also exposed served-build limits for the slate: Gallery's initial Dev-mode module request failed; the dialog Production directory URL rendered Portal chrome; and an OffscreenCanvas control invoked before canvas readiness raised an undefined Helper error. The successful actions above used the stated build and waited for the actual control/proxy/canvas state. No all-build quality pass is claimed.
